name: AIRevolution
storyline:
AIRevolution is a futuristic sci-fi visual novel set in a technologically advanced world where artificial intelligence, androids, and synthetic lifeforms have become an integral part of society. The player takes the role of a young protagonist navigating a sprawling metropolis filled with mystery, political intrigue, and rapidly evolving technology.

As he builds relationships with a diverse cast of characters—including humans, androids, and other artificial beings—he becomes entangled in secrets that could reshape the future of civilization. What begins as a personal journey of discovery gradually unfolds into a deeper story involving the true nature of artificial intelligence, hidden conspiracies, and the consequences of humanity's dependence on advanced technology.

Through choices, exploration, and character-driven interactions, players uncover the mysteries of this evolving world while forging bonds that influence both the narrative and the fate of those around them. AIRevolution combines romance, science fiction, and suspense in an ongoing story that expands with each new update.
summary: AIRevolution is a Visual Novel Game, sci-fi bathed with a shiny layer of fantasy. The world is crowded with Artificial intelligence, most of them looking like humans, they even managed to have the same rights as humans do in the 'near' future. Will you accept them as equals or.. choose another path? You better decide fast, an AIRevolution is incomming..
